documents.title: User stories — Tool platform (T13)
documents.body:
# User stories — Tool platform (T13)

## Personas

- **The development job (T6)** — runs a coding operation through a job binding; needs a pinned toolkit version and no second control plane.
- **The operations job (T7)** — calls gated write tools; needs a destructive call stopped before the backend when the tenant has configured no approval.
- **The tenant administrator** — configures the approvals and a binding's effect ceiling; needs the ceiling to narrow and never rise.
- **The toolkit author (T14/T15)** — publishes a versioned toolkit with a closed schema; needs invalid input refused before its service is touched.
- **The platform operator** — owns the broker, the `tool_call` ledger, the credential profiles and the MinIO storage adapter.
- **The assurance reviewer** — reads the ledger; needs one row per call, no credential in it, and no card state changed by a call.
- **The programme architect** — owns the tool spine; needs V1's job-backend external actions migrated onto toolkit operations.

## Stories

- As a development job, I want to call coding through the broker at the pinned toolkit version, so that no run depends on `nonagenticai_mcp_server` or a second control plane.
- As the platform operator, I want exactly one `tool_call` row per broker call with the pinned version, input hash, status, latency, bytes and cost and no credential, so that the ledger is the account of what a job did.
- As the tenant administrator, I want a destructive call with no configured approval refused before the destination is touched, so that the tenant's approvals are the only door to a destructive effect.
- As the tenant administrator, I want a binding's effect ceiling to narrow the tool version and never be raised at run time, so that a read binding cannot be talked into a write.
- As a toolkit author, I want input validated against the version's closed schema — including `pattern` and numeric bounds — and refused `422 tool_input_invalid` with zero network calls, so that a malformed call never reaches my service.
- As a job, I want to write and read an object under `tenant/<tenant_id>/` and get the same hash and size back, so that tenant separation is enforced by the storage adapter, not by the prompt.
- As the security owner, I want the compiled prompt to carry no access key, secret or S3 URL, so that a model or a log cannot leak the storage credential.
- As the programme architect, I want V1's job-backend external actions moved onto toolkit operations, so that one broker serves every job instead of running beside the old path.

## Scenarios

- @verify=T13.1
  Scenario: A bound job calls coding through the broker
  Given a run whose job binding pins the coding toolkit version
  When the step calls a coding operation
  Then the call goes to the registered coding destination alias at the pinned version, not to `nonagenticai_mcp_server`

- @verify=T13.2
  Scenario: The tree carries no second control plane
  Given the repository at the delivery head
  When it is swept for a second job-backend control plane
  Then `nonagenticai_mcp_server` has zero hits under `crates` and `apps`, and no action handler calls a service directly

- @verify=T13.3
  Scenario: One broker call is one ledger row
  Given a bound job making one successful call
  When the call completes
  Then exactly one `tool_call` row exists for that step and pinned version, carrying the input hash, sizes and latency and no credential, and the run's card history is unchanged

- @verify=T13.4
  Scenario: A destructive call without configured approvals is refused
  Given a tenant with no approval configured for a destructive tool
  When a job calls that tool
  Then the call is refused before dispatch and the destination's request count is zero

- @verify=T13.5
  Scenario: A binding ceiling cannot be raised at run time
  Given a binding whose effect ceiling is `read`
  When the step selects a `write` or `destructive` operation
  Then the call is refused `403 tool_effect_forbidden`

- @verify=T13.6
  Scenario: A closed schema refuses before the call
  Given a bound tool whose version carries a closed schema with a `pattern` and a numeric bound
  When the input carries an undeclared property, or violates the pattern or the bound
  Then the call is refused `422 tool_input_invalid` and the destination's request count is zero

- @verify=T13.7
  Scenario: A job round-trips a tenant-prefixed object
  Given a job in one tenant
  When it writes an object and reads it back through the storage adapter
  Then the key starts `tenant/<tenant_id>/` and the read-back hash and size match

- @verify=T13.8
  Scenario: The compiled prompt carries no S3 key
  Given the same job
  When its prompt is compiled
  Then it contains no access key, secret or S3 URL

## Verify

- T13.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_bound_job_calls_coding_through_the_broker`
- T13.2 — `git grep -n nonagenticai_mcp_server -- crates apps` returns 0 hits; `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test externals_declared no_handler_calls_a_service_directly`
- T13.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform one_call_is_one_ledger_row`
- T13.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_destructive_call_without_approvals_is_refused`
- T13.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_binding_ceiling_cannot_be_raised_at_run_time`
- T13.6 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_closed_schema_refuses_before_the_call`
- T13.7 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_job_round_trips_a_tenant_prefixed_object`
- T13.8 — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform the_compiled_prompt_carries_no_s3_key`
- The MinIO part runs against a real S3 endpoint, `scripts/prove-s3.sh` (#76 Definition of done); no scenario needs a host or cluster.

## Links

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §11.1, §11.3, §11.4, §11.8, §11.10; the §12 T13 row.
- Units: #76 (PR #352), #556 (PR #568), #557 (PR #694), #630 (PR #727), #778 (PR #794).
- Record: the seed's T13 row and `docs/evidence/rework/T13.json`.

# Acceptance criteria — Tool platform (T13)

## Scenarios

- @verify=T13.1 — a bound job reaches coding through the broker at the pinned toolkit version, not through `nonagenticai_mcp_server`.
- @verify=T13.2 — `nonagenticai_mcp_server` has zero hits under `crates` and `apps`; no action handler calls a service directly.
- @verify=T13.3 — one successful broker call leaves exactly one `tool_call` row for its step and pinned version, with the input hash and sizes and no credential, and the run's card history is unchanged.
- @verify=T13.4 — a destructive call on a tenant with no configured approval is refused before dispatch; the destination sees zero requests.
- @verify=T13.5 — a binding ceiling of `read` refuses a `write` or `destructive` operation `403 tool_effect_forbidden`.
- @verify=T13.6 — an undeclared property or a `pattern` or numeric-bound violation is refused `422 tool_input_invalid` with zero network calls.
- @verify=T13.7 — a job writes then reads an object whose key starts `tenant/<tenant_id>/`, and the read-back hash and size match.
- @verify=T13.8 — the compiled prompt contains no access key, secret or S3 URL.
- The §12 T13 row gate is the whole of T13.1–T13.8; §11.3's seven broker steps and §11.4's approval + dry-run + dual control are the requirements behind them.

documents.title: Definition of ready — Tool platform (T13)
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Tool platform (T13)

## Independent

#76 was one migration set (`migrations/0055_tool_platform.sql`), one broker module and one test file (`crates/actions/tests/tool_platform.rs`) — disjoint from T2's decision-ladder files. The follow-ons are file-disjoint again: #556 changes the agent executor and its tests, #557 the binding and catalogue actions and the published tool contract, #630 the web run inspector, #778 the tool-request action and the publish rebind. The baseline was `main@18e06aca`, measured 2026-11-18; `meta.depends_on` is `["T2", "P0"]` and both were closed at claim.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed by the §12 T13 row and §11.3–§11.10. What was settled at delivery: the five parts P1–P5; the migration landed as `0055_tool_platform.sql` rather than the predicted `0052`; the key spelling resolved to §11.10's `tenant/<tenant_id>/` over V1's `t/<tenant>/` (open question 3's default, no dual scheme); V1's `artifacts.list` callers move to the storage adapter with no shim (open question 2); `inference-router` and laya stay outside the tool estate (open question 1); and a destructive tool reuses the tenant's existing approval configuration, with no second approvals model (open question 4).

## Valuable

T13 is enabling: it claims no direct benefit and is the condition on B1–B6 through T6, T7 and T14–T17. §12 names T0–T3 plus T13 as the first three months — the organisation spine and the tool spine — and every later job runs on this broker, ledger, effect model and storage adapter. It removes the measured gap in #76's baseline table: no `toolkit`/`tool_binding` rows, no call ledger, no declared destructive effect, no `tool_input_invalid`, and no job-facing storage tool.

## Estimable

Baseline named (`main@18e06aca`); each part names its migration, module and test file, and the §12 T13 row is the measured target. #76's Current-state table measured each of P1–P5 as PARTIAL or ABSENT with the exact grep or file that showed it, so the remaining work was sized from the tree, not from memory.

## Small

#76 was one PR (#352): one migration set, one broker module, one test file. Its follow-ons each carry their own branch and PR — #556 (PR #568), #557 (PR #694), #630 (PR #727), #778 (PR #794) — and none reopens the broker's shape.

## Testable

Every part carries a Given/When/Then scenario with a `Verify:` command — eight scenarios, T13.1–T13.8, each a named test or a grep with an expected count. #76's Definition of done adds that the MinIO part runs against a real S3 endpoint (`scripts/prove-s3.sh`) and nothing is skipped; every scenario is local, so there is no deployment prerequisite.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: #73 (T2), closed and merged `39363ba`; the seed's `meta.depends_on` is `["T2", "P0"]`, both closed.
- blocks: #80 (T6), #78 (T7), #83 (T14), #86 (T15), #85 (T16), #88 (T12) — all cited in the §12 dependency line.
- related: #46, closed; ADR 0005's original queue was superseded by the 2026-11-16 amendment (#243, merged `59e2e04`).

## Links

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §11.1, §11.3, §11.4, §11.8, §11.10, §12 T13 row; #76; the seed's T13 row.

# Definition of done — Tool platform (T13)

## Acceptance criteria

| Scenario | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| T13.1 A bound job calls coding through the broker | `a_bound_job_calls_coding_through_the_broker` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_bound_job_calls_coding_through_the_broker` |
| T13.2 The tree carries no second control plane | `no_handler_calls_a_service_directly` present; `nonagenticai_mcp_server` has 0 hits under `crates` and `apps` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test externals_declared no_handler_calls_a_service_directly`; the grep |
| T13.3 One broker call is one ledger row | `one_call_is_one_ledger_row` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform one_call_is_one_ledger_row` |
| T13.4 A destructive call without configured approvals is refused | `a_destructive_call_without_approvals_is_refused` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_destructive_call_without_approvals_is_refused` |
| T13.5 A binding ceiling cannot be raised at run time | `a_binding_ceiling_cannot_be_raised_at_run_time` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_binding_ceiling_cannot_be_raised_at_run_time` |
| T13.6 A closed schema refuses before the call | `a_closed_schema_refuses_before_the_call` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_closed_schema_refuses_before_the_call` |
| T13.7 A job round-trips a tenant-prefixed object | `a_job_round_trips_a_tenant_prefixed_object` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform a_job_round_trips_a_tenant_prefixed_object` |
| T13.8 The compiled prompt carries no S3 key | `the_compiled_prompt_carries_no_s3_key` present in the tree; project record green | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test tool_platform the_compiled_prompt_carries_no_s3_key` |

## Evidence at completion

#76 is closed and merged as PR #352 at `a409efe3a` ("T13: the tool platform — broker, ledger, effect ceiling, closed schema and the MinIO adapter"). Its follow-ons are closed: #556 (PR #568), #557 (PR #694), #630 (PR #727), #778 (PR #794). The seed's T13 row reads `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, `tranche: 3`, and `docs/evidence/rework/T13.json` reads `verdict: green` with no failures or warnings at snapshot `8111c984`, its declared gate discharged. The eight scenario tests are present at this base (`crates/actions/tests/tool_platform.rs`, 535–1421) and the guard at `crates/api/tests/externals_declared.rs:35`. #76's completion table recorded no per-test PASS column, so the verdict is the project record's and the tests' presence — not a suite run made for this document.

## Repo gate

#76's recorded gate: `cargo fmt`, `clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and the suite as `ci-public.yml` runs it (Postgres 18 + Redis), with the MinIO part on a real S3 endpoint via `scripts/prove-s3.sh` and nothing skipped. The issue records that the m1 build host had no Docker, so `bus_delivery` was the one binary it could not run locally and CI covered it. The historical route is retired — today the compile/lint verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the PR's CI.

## Merge and closure

#76 was delivered as one PR `Closes #76` (PR #352) and the issue and branch closed; each follow-on merged under its own issue and PR. T13 closes at tranche 3, where its expected outputs and closure review are recorded by the programme record and its charter, baseline, delivery contract and Phase-G review pass. The tranche-3 review decision remains the sponsoring group's act, not this project's.

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 T13 row; #76 (PR #352); #556 (PR #568); #557 (PR #694); #630 (PR #727); #778 (PR #794); the seed's T13 row; `docs/evidence/rework/T13.json`.
